forms.title: Cave Dragon

forms.identity: Supreme high-capacity/high-potency dragon caster with armor, claws and harvest at premium SP prices; special emphasis on demonic magic.

nodes.effect: Scale unarmed/claw damage only in dragon body; no weapon-wide bonus.

nodes.label: Crushing Bite
nodes.effect: Bounded armor/knockback pressure on confirmed bite hits.

nodes.effect: Cooldown-limited landing shockwave against entities; terrain damage off by default.

nodes.label: Stonehide
nodes.effect: Incremental natural armor; respect equipment stacking caps.

nodes.label: Earthbound Poise
nodes.effect: Reduce knockback and fall damage while grounded.

nodes.label: Mountain Bastion
nodes.effect: Short defensive stance with a resource cost and meaningful cooldown, not permanent immunity.

nodes.label: Tunneler
nodes.effect: Improve legal claw-mining speed; preserve vanilla/tool harvest checks.

nodes.label: Vein Sense
nodes.effect: Short-range, timed ore awareness without unrestricted x-ray or chunk scans.

nodes.label: Deep Excavation
nodes.effect: Controlled multi-block excavation; count actual blocks, honor claims and server limits.

nodes.label: Infernal Resonance
nodes.effect: Bonus to source-verified demonic/infernal personal magic, beyond shared dragon arcane power but not world rituals.

nodes.label: Hellbound Command

forms.identity: Unarmed martial arts, unarmored body, motion and hand-harvest specialization

nodes.effect: Repeatable empty-hand damage bonus beyond the native +1 Open Palm unlock; stacking cap.

nodes.label: Flowing Counter
nodes.effect: Bounded counterattack after a verified native Guarding Palm/parry unlock.

nodes.effect: Improve real unarmed strike precision after native martial license. No innate Monk projectile; ranged spellcasting uses Ars Nouveau and Iron's.

nodes.label: Natural Poise

nodes.label: Hunger Discipline
nodes.effect: Bounded food/exhaustion efficiency after native license; do not remove all hunger.

nodes.label: Fire & Blast Tempering
nodes.effect: Limited environmental damage mitigation after both matching native licenses.

nodes.label: Body Speed
nodes.effect: Repeatable speed under no conventional gear discipline; native Fleet Footwork remains a one-off.

nodes.label: Balanced Landing
nodes.effect: Fall/knockback control; native Step Assist remains a one-off in native tree.

nodes.label: Glide Control
nodes.effect: Improve native momentum gliding only after rank-15 native unlock; never creative flight.

nodes.label: Barehand Efficiency
nodes.effect: Repeatable hand-mining speed; native Stone/Iron/Diamond/Netherite Fist unlock legal harvest tiers.

nodes.label: Fortunate Hands
nodes.effect: Bounded fortune-like bonus only after native rank-13 license and legitimate drop event.

nodes.label: Looting Palm
nodes.effect: Bounded unarmed looting after native rank-9 license; no creature-drop duplication.

capstone.label: Empty-Hand Paragon
capstone.effect: Full Monk native + Tyz progression must allow a skilled solo player to finish the real Chaos Guardian encounter with no worn gear and no weapons while honoring every legal boss mechanic; one-off capstone strengthens Monk's unmatched overall self-sufficient combat versatility.
capstone.external_gate: verified final native progression plus explicit late-game achievement

notes: Preserve the Monk native full skeleton (50 nodes, 6 pilot nodes) and 47 Monk-specific Tyz candidates as source inventories, NOT 47 new compulsory live skills.
First Sunset and native mastery from barehand breaks, kills and first foods stay separate from MXP global awards.
Step Assist after Fleet Footwork, not at rank one. Tool-free harvest tiers remain native permission unlocks.
Owner explicitly vetoed spirit projectile; first hotbar slot dedicated fist and free armor toggle are native/non-purchasable; native Treasure Hand is one Fortune/Silk Touch toggle.

Monk is the gear-independent combat apex; naked/unarmed Chaos Guardian solo remains the future QA goal. Against a comparably progressed FULLY GEARED specialist, balance aims for approximate overall parity, with slight specialist advantages in one or two niches.

Final balance uses gearless maxed Monk versus appropriately progressed THIS TREE WITH FULL tier-matched enchanted/Apotheosis-modified equipment, including Curios/weapons/tools, when legal to wear. Comparable overall power, slight specialty edge for geared forms.

dependency_contract.advanced: at least 1 rank of same-lane entry node plus verified native mid-stage
dependency_contract.mastery: at least 1 rank of same-lane advanced node plus verified native late-stage

concept_policy: The 96 existing node positions are exploratory, not an approved final list. In the design iteration below they are revised to embody new class identities; numbers/costs and final API bindings remain unapproved. OWNER DESIGN CEILING: maxed Monk naked/unarmed Chaos Guardian solo **at roughly the combat power of a fully progressed, appropriately geared specialist**, with specialist marginal niche edges (Dragon mana and power AFTER gear); Sea Dragon gets extraordinary Extreme ×50 Luck, see 165-row strength catalog.

dragons.spell_power: substantially larger spell potency gain per SP than other paths (above Core Skills for the same budget), only on truly scalable personal spells
dragons.mana_regeneration: NO dragon-specific mana or magic-resource regeneration bonuses. Universal Core Skills Wellspring remains purchasable and is not disabled by becoming a dragon; this is about dragon-exclusive skill bonuses, not a global regen prohibition.
dragons.price_rule: dragon physical armor/damage/harvest ranks have higher SP prices for similar benefit than specialized melee/harvest identities; dragon magic/mana ranks have highest value per SP
dragons.source_policy: enhance native spell schools/resource meters without inventing shared mana or bypassing harvest constraints; dragon family bonuses must not stack more than one species
dragons.cave: demonic/infernal spell and owned demon-servant synergy; source classes verified in Goety/related mods
dragons.forest: fae magic/owned fae synergy plus bonemeal utility, controlled animal-breeding improvements and extra valid crop yields
dragons.sea: provisional tide/ice/storm/abyssal spell affinity and aquatic control; choose source-verified spell tags/mod hooks before promising specific school coverage

lich.specialty: blood magic (e.g. actual eligible Neo Vitae, EvilCraft personal activations) and necromancy
lich.tradeoff: purchasing the blood-specialist skill boosts verified personal blood spell power while reducing that same lich player's eligible nature-magic potency (Botania/Roots); penalty is not a debuff cast on enemies
lich.stage_policy: tradeoff magnitudes grow or scale with the purchased investment, remain meaningful even after universal Core Skills Potency and do not modify world mana machines or crafting infra
lich.source_policy: build source-tagged positive and negative spell effect hooks; do not touch unrelated passive generation or apply a modwide nerf; preserve Archlich and Dracolich lifecycle semantics

werewolf.identity: enormous extra maximum HP (hearts), strong but bounded actual health regeneration and boosts to nature spellcasting
werewolf.survival_distinction: health regen, not infinite mana regeneration; native silver/mob vulnerabilities and wolf-form restrictions remain meaningful
werewolf.balance: more health and HP regen per SP than general Core Skills/Dragon physical ranks; verified Botania/Roots nature-spell potency boosts, with explicit spell/cast classification

forest_dragon_agriculture.bonemeal: improve actual bonemeal effects or resource efficiency; avoid free infinite bonemeal cycles
forest_dragon_agriculture.animals: improve eligible animal breeding/husbandry through verified events; do not multiply animals automatically or ignore cooldowns
forest_dragon_agriculture.crop: extra legal crop outcomes on committed harvest events, with anti-double-credit vs Green Thumb, Harvest with Ease, and protected claims

overall_balance_2026_11_15.compare: Monk with full skills and no equipped gear vs other class with comparable progression plus expected enchanted/Affixed equipment and Curios.
overall_balance_2026_11_15.total_power: Approximately balanced overall, not Monk far above all geared builds.
overall_balance_2026_11_15.dragon: Dragon with full tier-appropriate mana/spell gear slightly exceeds maxed equipment-free Monk for max mana and practical spell power.

source_retirement_architecture: JAWR-only vampire/wolf physiology; standalone Hunter/Monk; no TeamLapen provider for future

global_power_ceiling_2026_11_15.apex: Monk—best INTRINSIC / no-gear all-around fighter; NOT assumed stronger than appropriately geared comparably progressed specialists.
global_power_ceiling_2026_11_15.benchmark: Maxed Monk must solo real Chaos Guardian with no worn equipment or weapons and real boss mechanics. For balanced progression compare its FULL no-gear kit against specialist FULL gear-inclusive kit.
global_power_ceiling_2026_11_15.specialist_rule: Geared alternative progression paths should be broadly competitive in total combat capability, allowed slightly more strength in one or two specializations. Fully geared Dragon should be slightly above no-gear maxed Monk in effective personal max mana and spell potency AFTER equipped enchantments, Apotheosis affixes/gems and Curios are counted.
global_power_ceiling_2026_11_15.loadout_comparator: Appropriately-tiered armor, weapons/tools, enchanting, Apotheosis affixes/reforges/socketed gems, Curios and legal casting equipment on the non-Monk. Monk uses no worn gear and no weapons in strict Guardian benchmark. No naked-to-naked comparison as the target.
global_power_ceiling_2026_11_15.evaluation: Compare real observed full-build endgame performance, including effect procs and equipment restrictions. Same progress milestones and normalized MXP/SP budgets; realistic accessible gear tier.
global_power_ceiling_2026_11_15.test_status: conceptual target, not approved numeric parity and not tested
